requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Syntactic and lexical ambiguities regarding the physical interaction with the card reader and keypad were resolved using business rule BR-01 and domain definitions. The requirement was decomposed into a single functional requirement describing the sequence of inserting the card and entering the code.

source_fragments: The user enters the access card with the access code.

fields.condition: the user inserts the access card into the card reader and then enters the access code on the keypad

structured_requirements.final_statement: The user shall insert the access card into the card reader and then enter the access code on the keypad.
structuring_notes: Resolved syntactic ambiguity: 'enters the access card' interpreted as physical insertion per BR-01.
Resolved lexical ambiguity: 'enters the access code' interpreted as digital input on keypad per BR-01.
Combined sequence of actions into a single functional requirement statement.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume specific authentication logic (e.g., AND vs OR) beyond the sequential action described.
